env.CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX.desc: Prefix command wrapped around every spawned shell command
env.CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.desc: Path to a script sourced in the same shell process before every Bash command
env.CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH.desc: Path to Git Bash's bash.exe on Windows
env.CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING: Return to the original working directory after every Bash command
env.CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER.desc: Enterprise launcher command wrapping background processes spawned by Claude Code
env.CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_HIDDEN.desc: Whether Glob results include dotfiles (included by default; false excludes them)
env.CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_NO_IGNORE.desc: Set to false to make Glob honour .gitignore
env.CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY.desc: Keep the terminal's native cursor so screen magnifiers can follow it
env.CLAUDE_CODE_NATIVE_CURSOR.desc: Show the terminal's own cursor at the insertion point instead of drawing a block
env.CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER.desc: Enable fullscreen rendering that reduces flicker
Repaint the whole screen every frame in fullscreen rendering
env.CLAUDE_CODE_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHT.desc: Set to false to turn off syntax highlighting in diff output
env.CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD.desc: Hide the working directory in the startup logo, useful for screen recordings
env.CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_AUTO_OPEN.desc: Open the browser automatically when a new artifact is published (0 disables)
env.CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER.desc: Emit flat text with no decorative borders or animations
env.CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR.desc: Override the debug log file path (debug mode must also be on)
env.IS_DEMO.desc: Demo mode: hide the email address and organization name
